notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key.
Data release version indicator; stored as an observation with value_as_string = 'NHANES 2001-2002 Public Release'.
Interview/examination status; stored as observation. Can be used to filter cohorts (e.g., only MEC examined).
Six-month exam period; stored as observation. May influence seasonality adjustments.
Male → 8507, Female → 8532. Direct mapping to OMOP gender concepts.
Age at screening; year_of_birth can be derived as (screening_year - RIDAGEYR). Topcoded at 85.
Age in months at screening; stored as observation for precision beyond year_of_birth.
Age in months at exam; stored as observation. Useful for pediatric growth calculations.
Combined race/ethnicity recode. Map to race_concept_id and ethnicity_concept_id using standard OMOP concepts (e.g., Mexican American → Hispanic ethnicity, specific race).
Alternative linked race/ethnicity recode. Use similarly to RIDRETH1; may provide finer granularity.
Veteran status; concept 4052017 (Military service status). Values: Yes/No/Refused/Don't know.
Country of birth; map to OMOP place concepts (e.g., USA, Mexico, Elsewhere).
US citizenship status; concept 4052020 (Citizenship status).
Length of time in US; stored as observation with ordinal categories.
Education level for children 6-19; concept 40767402 (Educational attainment).
Education level for adults 20+; same concept as DMDEDUC3.
Old education recode; stored as observation with collapsed categories.
Current school attendance; stored as observation.
Marital status; concept 4052021 (Marital status).
Household size; stored as observation.
Annual household income (bracketed); concept 40769038 (Annual household income).
Annual family income (bracketed); concept 40769039 (Annual family income).
Poverty income ratio; stored as continuous observation (value_as_number).
Pregnancy status at exam; concept 4030943 (Pregnancy status).
Old pregnancy status recode; same concept as RIDEXPRG.
Household reference person gender; not directly mapped to participant's person record. Can be stored as observation if needed.
Household reference person age; not a participant attribute. Skip or store as observation.
Household reference person country of birth; skip or store as observation.
Household reference person education; skip or store as observation.
Household reference person marital status; skip or store as observation.
Spouse of household reference person education; skip or store as observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight; stored as observation with value_as_number. Used for survey-weighted analyses.
Full sample 4-year interview weight (1999-2002); stored as observation.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight; stored as observation. Essential for MEC-based analyses.
Full sample 4-year MEC exam weight (1999-2002); stored as observation.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU; stored as observation for survey design specification.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum; stored as observation for survey design specification.
